summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also in effect under a disabled fieldset ancestor, without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Moves from start to end when on; follows the writing direction.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl: setFormValue(value) only while on; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError); formResetCallback restores the checked attribute default; formStateRestore restores on/off; disabled (own or from a fieldset, through isDisabled) is not submitted; <label for> activates it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (24x16 for sm); the label is part of the clickable row, and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; on/off exposed as aria-checked natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as soon as it is flipped
The setting needs a consequence explained
A form field must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

antiPatterns.pattern: A yes/no choice that is recorded and applied only on submit
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate setting; Checkbox records a choice
The label is the only name for the switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default track is a translucent input color; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference Switch (sizes default and sm, label row) and the APG switch pattern.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> or a custom role=switch element?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role=switch: Space, focus, validity and form participation come with it (rule form-associated-controls, NativeControl).

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and do description and error live inside the component?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, as in Checkbox and Input: shadow DOM keeps outside labels from naming the inner input. hide-label keeps it as the name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: size = default | sm (as the visual reference), mapped to medium | small by the API alias table; 32x20 and 24x16 tracks from the existing size.switch tokens.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean, and is checked reflected?
openQuestions.answer: required means the switch must be on (native valueMissing). checked is not reflected: the attribute is the reset default, as in Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle?
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the form (SB-0009). The APG makes Enter optional.

openQuestions.question: On/Off text in the track, or a read-only state?
openQuestions.answer: Neither: not in the reference. Revisit on request.
